title: KidneyLink Healthcare Platform
summary: Healthcare platform connecting kidney patients, organ donors, and specialized healthcare providers.
problem: Matching organ donors with kidney disease patients requires secure, centralized data coordination and urgent communication channels.
solution: Developed a confidential medical portal providing donor-patient matching assistance, hospital directory access, and healthcare records management.
features: Secure donor registration and compatibility parameter matching
Patient assistance portal linking patients with specialized dialysis centers and doctors
Role-based access control ensuring medical data privacy and compliance
